sources.title: README.md · cstr/fastpitch-en-GGUF at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: FastPitch (English) + HiFi-GAN — GGUF (ggml) GGUF / ggml conversion of nvidia/tts_en_fastpitch + nvidia/tts_hifigan for use with CrispStrobe/CrispASR. FastPitch is a non-autoregressive parallel TTS model that generates the entire mel spectrogram in a single forward pass (no sampling, no KV cache), making it very fast.

sources.title: basic-pitch: Audio-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Q: Can I use basic-pitch for polyphonic music transcription? A: The model is designed for monophonic (single-instrument) transcription and works best when you provide audio containing one melodic line at a time. While it can process polyphonic audio, accuracy degrades significantly with multiple simultaneous instruments or dense chords.
